summary: 3D companion for WoW: Forever who talks, reacts and points the way: a portrait window with her model, a compass wisp toward your next objective, zone lore and banter in three voices (Nicole, Kahani, Shelley). Every voice's everyday lines are built in; full voices (zone comments and zone histories) are separate voice packs. Gathering, quest guides, nameplates, marker wheel, loot and reminders are separate Companion modules.
